<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[You're So Cute!](/Feats.aspx?ID=5306) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 26

</column>

---

You know how to put on the charm, doing playful tricks to win favor. You are trained in [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) and gain the [Impressive Performance](/Feats.aspx?ID=5159) feat. When performing for [humanoids](/Traits.aspx?ID=628), you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392) with Performance.
name: You're So Cute!
